reason: The passage explicitly demonstrates God's active support for the Hebrew people. God blesses the midwives (וַיֵּ֥יטֶב אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֑ת - 'God dealt well with the midwives') who feared Him and refused to obey Pharaoh's command to kill Hebrew infant boys. The direct result is that 'the people multiplied and became very strong' (וַיִּ֧רֶב הָעָ֛ם וַיַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ מְאֹֽד). God's protective action toward the Hebrew people and His reward to those who facilitate their survival clearly indicate that supporting the Hebrew people is among Yahweh's priorities and goals.
